claims.content: Reason should identify an actionable target instead of endlessly cataloging unwanted outcomes. The revised text assigns deliberate goal selection and current sensory attention to conscious thought, and situates execution in the automatic metaphor.

evidence_assessments.title: Conscious reason can overwrite every negative response
